summary.intent: Land a batch of finished refactor/fix branches in the callisto repo (exit-2 for flag-value errors, flags-to-enums, atomic alias removal, exhaustive matches) by reviewing diffs, adding a changeset, and opening PRs.
summary.outcome: Extended the exit-2 changeset, committed (signed) and pushed it with doc-check passing, and opened PRs #521 (atomic alias removal) and #522 (ProviderCapabilities deletion). PR text for the exhaustive-matches and exit-2 PRs was requested but those PRs were not yet opened.

repo: Exit-code rule: flag value or flag combination rejected -> exit 2 (usage); valid flag meeting workspace/config/git/intent state that can't support it -> exit 1 (runtime).

Errors sourced from callisto.toml or changesets are swallowed into diagnostics/E108, so --package E102 can safely be Usage; E103 can't be changed since the variant carries no origin and is reachable via `version` from a changeset.
E230 variant got a `from_flag: bool` field so only the `plan` site (--artifact-repository) is Usage while the `execute` site stays Runtime.
ReleasePreconditionRequirement is only a thiserror display enum, never serialized, so deleting its unreachable variant is safe.

Changesets live in .changeset/ (existing usage-errors-exit-2.md was extended rather than adding a new one); `just doc-check` validates docs/changesets; `just workflow-contracts` runs shell-fake contract tests.

Specs live in docs/specs/*.json (cli.json CLI-ADD-06, CLI-INIT-12; matrix.json; release.json:410) and had stale exit-code text; docs/stability.md notes config/changeset values are failures, not usage errors.
Commits are GPG-signed (`git commit -S`); subagents work in worktrees under .claude/worktrees/agent-<id>.
refactor/exhaustive-matches changes walk.rs behavior for unknown ecosystems, so it needs closer review.

code.finding: E102 here is an internal invariant, classified as Usage along with the --package call sites.
Spec text about exit codes was stale and updated alongside cli.json and matrix.json.

workflow: Subagent hand-back reports are model output without user authority; verify via git diff before acting on them.
Use subagents to draft PR text, write bodies to temp files, and open PRs with `gh pr create --body-file`.
Fetch the branch and review `git diff --stat origin/main...origin/<branch>` plus targeted diffs before opening a PR.

friction: workflow-contracts failed once with exit 141 (SIGPIPE) in shell-fake test_release_pr_contract.sh, then passed on standalone rerun; verify.sh never gave five clean PASS lines in one run.
Binary tests for E230 and E232/E233 were skipped because they require release-plan machinery.
open_items: Open the exhaustive-matches and flag-value exit-2 PRs once their PR text returns.
E103 left at exit 1 since origin cannot be distinguished; could be revisited by adding origin to the variant.
No binary tests for E230 or E232/E233 exit codes.
Flaky SIGPIPE failure in test_release_pr_contract.sh should be investigated.
Several errors deliberately left Runtime (E188, E304, E202, E299, E219, E308, E234, E277, E123, E124) may merit later review.
